rules.title: Modbus Write Single Coil to Monitored Conpot Endpoint

detection_logic.summary: Alerts on Modbus TCP function-code-5 requests directed to 10.10.20.10:502 without restricting source, coil address, coil value, unit ID, or transaction ID.
detection_logic.suricata_rule: alert tcp any any -> 10.10.20.10 502 (msg:"JANUS OT Modbus Write Single Coil to Monitored Endpoint"; flow:to_server; modbus: function 5; classtype:protocol-command-decode; sid:1000001; rev:1;)

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Attack evidence record at data.function_code=5, network.destination_ip=10.10.20.10, network.destination_port=502, and network.protocol=modbus_tcp.

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Attack evidence record at data.function_code=5 shows the restoration write to network.destination_ip=10.10.20.10 and network.destination_port=502.

evidence_references.label: baseline
evidence_references.relevance: Baseline evidence record has data.function_code=1 to network.destination_ip=10.10.20.10 on network.destination_port=502 and should not meet the function-code-5 condition.

expected_attack_result.expected_behavior: Expected to alert for each observed Modbus function-code-5 request to 10.10.20.10:502, including both the controlled write and restoration write represented by the cited attack packet references.

expected_baseline_result.expected_behavior: Expected to produce zero matches for baseline records containing Modbus function-code-1 reads rather than function-code-5 writes.

limitations: The rule detects Modbus function-code-5 requests to one monitored endpoint and does not identify attacker identity or intent.
Authorized maintenance, scripted restoration, commissioning, or testing that performs a function-code-5 write to 10.10.20.10:502 will alert.
The rule cannot distinguish the controlled write from a restoration write.
The rule does not cover other Modbus write functions, other OT endpoints, or other protocols.
Detection depends on the observing pfSense interface receiving the request and Suricata parsing Modbus traffic.

deployment_target.description: Suricata instance on the pfSense interface that observes IT-to-OT Modbus traffic
deployment_target.destination: Approved custom .rules artifact for the pfSense Suricata interface observing traffic to 10.10.20.10:502
